communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Oklahoma Open Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

copies of public records concerning municipal code-enforcement actions within the City of El Reno.

Specifically, I request a digital copy, spreadsheet, or log of all residential code-enforcement violations, citations, and notices issued from January 1, 2026, through the date this request is processed.

To limit clerical search time, please provide the information in its existing electronic format, such as Excel, CSV, or a text file. I am requesting only the following fields:

- Property owner’s or responsible party’s name
- Street address
- Violation type
- Date the violation was recorded or notice was issued

If the City does not maintain a centralized spreadsheet or log containing these fields, please provide the existing underlying electronic records from which this information can be extracted.

If any responsive record does not contain the property owner’s or responsible party’s name, please provide the remaining requested fields rather than withholding the entire record.

If the estimated cost will exceed $25, please provide an itemized estimate before processing the request. I request that any fees be waived because the records will be made available to the general public and concern the enforcement of municipal health, safety, and property-maintenance laws.

If any portion of this request is denied, withheld, or redacted, please identify the specific statutory exemption under the Oklahoma Open Records Act supporting that decision and release all reasonably segregable portions of the records.

Thank you for your attention and cooperation.

Sincerely,

AJ Keys

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days.

Sincerely,

AJ Keys

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Sincerely,

M
